Hi Doctor,

I'm reaching out because I've been experiencing some concerning symptoms that seem to be related to food allergies. Randomly, I'll eat something and suddenly my eyes will become extremely watery, it's like they're streaming non-stop. It's not just a little tearing, it's a lot. I know I'm not getting any younger, and I don't want to take any chances. I'd love to get your take on this and figure out what's going on. Should I come in for an appointment or try to keep a food diary to see if we can identify any patterns?

Thanks so much for your time, I look forward to hearing from you.

Best,
Margaret
